user_problem: Validation requirements from different notes overlap or contradict each other in ways implementers cannot safely resolve.
unique_output: A field-level conflict map showing rule intersections, contradictions, precedence statements, and undecidable cases.
required_input: Labeled validation rules, their scopes, source IDs, and any explicit precedence or exception clauses.
critical_rule: Apply precedence only when supplied; never resolve conflicting limits by preference or apparent strictness.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is decision-evidence-ledger; this analyzes operational rule compatibility rather than separating decisions, proposals, and assumptions.
acceptance_scenario: Input R1 says username length 4–20 globally; R2 says partner usernames 3–20; no precedence. Output flags the partner minimum conflict, preserves both sources, and marks resolution required.
